# Template — Member-Run Savings Group Rules (mutual-pool documentation)

> ⚠️ **Template only — professional/regulatory review required before use.**
> Purpose: a written constitution for a **member-run** savings & loan group
> (rotating or accumulating savings model), in plain universal language —
> the substance of mutual risk-sharing and community solidarity, with no
> religious framing and no Arabic terminology.
>
> **Critical boundaries (read first):**
> - The group is **run by its own members**; money moves only between
>   members (or via a licensed bank/mobile-money account the members
>   control). **AgriSphere is a documentation layer only** — it never holds,
>   collects or moves group money and is not a party to the group's rules.
> - Taking deposits from non-members or lending to the public may constitute
>   regulated deposit-taking/banking in many jurisdictions. **This template
>   is for closed, member-only groups.** If the group grows beyond members,
>   consult a licensed institution or regulator first.
> - Review with a lawyer/cooperative adviser; fill every `[bracket]`.

**Group name:** `[e.g. Tswapong Women's Savings Circle]`
**Formed:** `[date]` at `[village/ward]`
**Members (schedule A):** `[names + contact; add as joined]`

## 1. Objects (what the group is for)
1. Regular saving together, in fixed shares, to build a member-only fund.
2. Zero-interest or low-cost loans to members for declared purposes
   `[e.g. inputs, school fees, medical needs, small trade]` on agreed order
   and rotation.
3. Mutual support in hardship (death, illness, verified crop/livestock
   loss) under §6.

## 2. Membership
1. Open to `[criteria, e.g. adult residents of the village who farm]`.
2. Joining: application to the committee; pays joining share `[P·]` and
   first share.
3. Leaving: written notice; refund of the member's own savings `[within ·
   days of the group's next meeting]` **less any outstanding loan balance**;
   no share of other members' money.
4. Expulsion: by two-thirds vote for dishonesty or persistent default, with
   a right to be heard first; savings refunded per §2.3.

## 3. Shares, savings & the fund
1. Regular share: `[P·]` per `[week/month]` per member.
2. Payment: in cash at meetings or into the group's bank/mobile account
   `[account details held by the treasurer, two-signature control]`.
3. The fund = member savings + joining shares + fines (§7) + interest/
   margins earned under §4. All money is accounted at every meeting and
   reconciled to the bank/mobile record.

## 4. Loans to members
1. Loan size: up to `[·]`× the member's own saved share, and never more
   than `[P·]` or `[·]%` of the fund, whichever is lower.
2. **Cost:** `[zero interest / a transparent service margin of ·% per
   period, decided by members and written here]`. No other charges.
3. Order: rotation list first; urgent hardship may jump the queue by
   majority vote (max `[·]` jumps at once).
4. Purpose: declared at application `[e.g. inputs]`; the group may ask for
   evidence `[e.g. AgriSphere programme contract or receipt]` but does not
   police the member's use beyond declared intent.
5. Repayment: `[e.g. equal instalments over · weeks starting · week after
   draw]`. Early repayment allowed with no penalty.
6. Default: the group first **helps** (restructure over · more weeks, no
   extra charge); if the member still does not pay, the guarantee rules
   (§5) and expulsion (§2.4) apply. **No physical seizure, no public
   shaming, no compounding penalties — ever.**

## 5. Guarantees (mutual support in substance)
1. Every loan is backed by the members jointly (each member guarantees a
   share) **or** by 1–2 named co-guarantors from the group.
2. On default after restructuring, guarantors cover the shortfall in
   agreed shares; the group pursues the defaulting member civilly if needed.

## 6. Hardship & solidarity fund
1. `[·]%` of each share goes to a hardship sub-fund, used only for
   verified member hardship `[e.g. funeral support P·, illness visit P·]`.
2. Hardship claims are verified by two committee members; payments are
   recorded and reported to members. The sub-fund is never lent out.

## 7. Committee, meetings & records
1. Committee: chair, treasurer, secretary, `[·]` — elected `[annually]`,
   no more than `[·]` consecutive terms.
2. Meetings: `[weekly/monthly]`; quorum `[·]` members; decisions by simple
   majority except expulsion/rule changes (two-thirds).
3. Records: cash book + member ledger (contributions, loans, balances),
   reconciled `[monthly]` and open to any member. AgriSphere may store the
   group's rules and ledger **as documents only** — money records remain
   with the treasurer/bank.
4. Treasurer bond/control: `[e.g. two signatories; no single member handles
   cash alone; count cash at each meeting]`.
5. Theft/loss by a committee member: immediate suspension, full repayment
   demanded, and reporting to `[police / cooperative office]` where
   appropriate.

## 8. Dissolution
By two-thirds vote: repay all member savings first, then settle any
outstanding loans, then distribute any surplus equally among members (or to
`[charity]` by vote). Books closed with a final written statement.

## 9. Review & law
1. Rules reviewed `[annually]`; amendments written and signed.
2. Governing law: `[Botswana / ·]`. If the group registers as a
   cooperative society or similar, these rules must be replaced by the
   regulator's model rules `[·]`.
3. **Regulatory note:** members confirm they are not operating a deposit-
   taking business open to the public; the group is closed to members only.
